hero_img_alt: Highway construction site by the Schnorpfeil Group
vp_1_desc: Road construction, earthworks, structural engineering, specialized civil engineering — we execute the infrastructure projects others decline. Interfaces between trades are not managed, they are eliminated.
vp_2_desc: Over 1,000 internal experts and a state-of-the-art machinery fleet — at Schnorpfeil, you don't depend on subcontractors. You lead your project.
vp_3_desc: Since 1948, we build the arteries of the economy. Our work is driven on, flown over, and relied upon — for decades to come.
intro_par1: With approximately 1,000 employees, the Schnorpfeil Group is one of the largest family-run construction companies in Germany. Road construction, earthworks, civil engineering, repairs, and special construction – Schnorpfeil offers a completely integrated range of services from a single source. This ensures smooth management of interfaces between trades.
intro_par2: New foundations and acquisitions continuously expand our range of services in infrastructure construction. Extensive, forward-looking investments in machinery drive our development. This enables us to offer our customers demanding construction services across the entire spectrum of infrastructure construction.
intro_par3: Since 1948, we have been building the future – with passion, innovation, and expertise.
hub_subtitle: Get to know the subsidiaries within our group and learn more about our broad range of services.
sub1_desc: A trusted partner for outstanding construction projects for over 75 years — from road and civil engineering to asphalt, concrete and structural bridge construction.
sub2_desc: Your partner for quality and safety on the road: concrete safety barriers, slipform construction, concrete surfaces and traffic safety — simple, fast and reliable.
sub3_desc: Pioneering large-scale projects in the Rhine-Main metropolitan region and beyond: airport construction, railway construction and energy infrastructure at the highest level.
sub4_desc: Naturally layered Moselle greywacke as building and design material, plus a complete range of building materials — from natural stone to road surfacing.
sub5_desc: No. 1 for safe construction: modular vehicle restraint systems in cast-in-place concrete — research, testing and development of barriers, transitions and system accessories.
sub6_desc: Soil landfill with integrated construction debris recycling — recovering recycled aggregates and sands for resource-efficient use in road construction.
sub7_desc: Your specialist for separation cuts, joint cutting, joint sealing and concrete rehabilitation — WHG-certified specialist company with state-of-the-art technology.
sub8_desc: Horizontal directional drilling and specialized civil engineering for trenchless pipe installation — precise, efficient and gentle on existing infrastructure.
sub9_desc: Supra-regional contractor for concrete safety barriers, RAL-certified steel protection systems, slipform construction and concrete pavements, based in the Ruhr area.
sub10_desc: Your partner for construction site transport and building material logistics — reliable, flexible and with a state-of-the-art fleet for on-time deliveries.
sub11_desc: Suction instead of digging: precise extraction where conventional methods reach their limits — efficient, high-performance and targeted in civil engineering.

legal_privacy_content:
1. Data Protection at a Glance (Privacy by Design)

General Information
We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This website is built according to the principles of "Privacy by Design" and "Privacy by Default", complying with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the German Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG).

No Cookies & No Tracking
This website uses neither cookies nor tracking or analytics tools (such as Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, etc.). We do not create user profiles and we do not evaluate your browsing behaviour. We do not pass your data on to third parties for advertising, analytics or profiling purposes. The hosting provider technically required to operate the website is described in section 4.

No Fonts, Maps or Videos from Third-Party Servers
All fonts, images, logos and scripts are served exclusively from our own web space. No Google Fonts, map services, embedded videos or third-party content delivery networks are loaded. Simply visiting this website therefore does not establish any connection to third-party servers.

Local Storage for Theme Preferences
Your browser's local storage (localStorage: schnorpfeil-theme) is used solely to remember your chosen colour scheme (Light Mode, Blue Mode, or following your operating system setting). Only the value "light" or "blue" is stored; if you follow the system setting, the entry is removed again. The value is not linked to your person and never leaves your browser. This function serves exclusively the correct display of the website and is exempt from consent under Section 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG. You can delete the entry at any time via your browser settings.

2. Responsible Controller

The controller within the meaning of Art. 4 (7) GDPR is:

Heinz Schnorpfeil Bau GmbH
Kastellauner Str. 51
56253 Treis-Karden
Germany
Phone: +49 (0) 2672 69-0
Fax: +49 (0) 2672 69-50
E-Mail: info@schnorpfeil.com
Managing Directors: Elmar Schnorpfeil, Rainer Hoffmann, Marc Stang

3. Data Protection Officer

We have appointed an official Data Protection Officer for our company:

Stefan Krumbhorn
Fährstraße 75
56333 Winningen, Germany
E-Mail: schnorpfeil@datenschutz-2k.de

4. Hosting and Server Log Files

This website is hosted via GitHub Pages; the provider is GitHub, Inc., San Francisco, USA. When you access the website, your browser automatically transmits technical data which is recorded in server log files on the provider's infrastructure: IP address, date and time of access, name and URL of the retrieved file, transmitted data volume, browser type, operating system and referrer URL.

This logging takes place exclusively on the provider's systems and serves the technical delivery, stability and security of the website. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) lit. f GDPR. We have no access to these log files, we do not evaluate them and we do not merge them with other data. GitHub does not state a fixed retention period; GitHub's privacy statement applies.

In the course of this, personal data – in particular your IP address – may be transferred to servers in the USA. GitHub is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, for which an adequacy decision of the European Commission exists; in addition, the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses apply. You may obtain a copy of these safeguards on request using the contact details given in section 2.

5. Contact by E-Mail or Phone

When you contact us by email or telephone, the information you provide, including your contact details, is processed in order to handle your enquiry and for the event of follow-up questions. Processing is based on Art. 6 (1) lit. b GDPR (where your enquiry serves the performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures) or on Art. 6 (1) lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in the effective handling of enquiries addressed to us). The data remains with us until the purpose for storage ceases to apply or statutory retention periods take effect.

This website does not contain a contact form. Contact is made exclusively via the telephone numbers and email addresses we provide.

6. Encryption (SSL/TLS)

For security reasons this website uses SSL/TLS encryption. You can recognise an encrypted connection by the fact that your browser's address bar displays "https://". When encryption is active, the data you transmit to us cannot be read by third parties.

7. External Links and Social Media Profiles

Our website links to external offerings – including websites of group and subsidiary companies, employee portals and our profiles on Facebook, LinkedIn, XING, Instagram and YouTube.

These are plain hyperlinks only. We do not use social media plugins, "Like" buttons, iFrames or embedded third-party content. Your data is therefore only transmitted to the respective provider once you actively click such a link and open the target page. The respective provider alone is responsible for the data processing on the linked pages; their privacy policies apply.

8. No Obligation to Provide Data, No Automated Decision-Making

This website can be used without providing personal data. You are under no legal or contractual obligation to provide us with personal data. The server log files described in section 4 arise for technical reasons when the connection is established and are necessary for delivering the website.

Automated decision-making, including profiling within the meaning of Art. 22 (1) and (4) GDPR, does not take place.

9. Your Rights as a Data Subject

Under the GDPR you have the right at any time to:

  • Access to your stored personal data (Art. 15 GDPR)
  • Rectification of incorrect or completion of incomplete data (Art. 16 GDPR)
  • Erasure of your data (Art. 17 GDPR)
  • Restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
  • Data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
  • Object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR – see the separate notice in section 10)
  • Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR)

To exercise your rights, an informal message to the contact details given in section 2 or to our Data Protection Officer (section 3) is sufficient. Exercising these rights is free of charge for you.

10. Right to Object to Data Processing (Art. 21 GDPR)

IF THE PROCESSING OF YOUR PERSONAL DATA IS BASED ON ART. 6 (1) LIT. F GDPR, YOU HAVE THE RIGHT TO OBJECT TO THIS PROCESSING AT ANY TIME ON GROUNDS RELATING TO YOUR PARTICULAR SITUATION. WE WILL THEN NO LONGER PROCESS THE PERSONAL DATA CONCERNED UNLESS WE CAN DEMONSTRATE COMPELLING LEGITIMATE GROUNDS FOR THE PROCESSING WHICH OVERRIDE YOUR INTERESTS, RIGHTS AND FREEDOMS, OR THE PROCESSING SERVES THE ESTABLISHMENT, EXERCISE OR DEFENCE OF LEGAL CLAIMS.

Please address your objection informally to the contact details given in section 2 or to our Data Protection Officer (section 3).

11. Competent Supervisory Authority

Without prejudice to any other administrative or judicial remedy, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. The authority competent for us is:

Der Landesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit Rheinland-Pfalz
Hintere Bleiche 34, 55116 Mainz, Germany
Website: https://www.datenschutz.rlp.de

12. Status and Amendments to this Privacy Policy

We will amend this privacy policy as soon as changes to our data processing or to the legal framework make this necessary. The version published on this page applies in each case.

faq_q1: What does the Schnorpfeil Group do?
faq_a1: The Schnorpfeil Group is a family-run infrastructure construction company founded in 1948, based in Treis-Karden, Germany. With over 1,000 employees and 11 specialized subsidiaries, the group covers the entire spectrum of infrastructure construction: road construction, civil engineering, earthworks, asphalt and concrete construction, concrete safety barriers, slipform construction, vehicle restraint systems, horizontal directional drilling, raw material extraction, recycling, and construction logistics.
faq_q2: Which subsidiaries belong to the Schnorpfeil Group?
faq_a2: The group includes: Heinz Schnorpfeil Bau GmbH, WALLSTOP GmbH & Co. KG, Schnorpfeil Rhein-Main GmbH & Co. KG, Heinz Schnorpfeil Baustoff GmbH & Co. KG (Mosel-Grauwacke), LINETECH GmbH & Co. KG, Baugesellschaft Gebr. Benkelberg & Co. GmbH, HSK Fugen- und Betonsanierung GmbH & Co. KG, InfraLine GmbH, VSB infra GmbH & Co. KG, Schnorpfeil Transport GmbH & Co. KG, and Der Saugbagger.
faq_q3: Where does the Schnorpfeil Group operate?
faq_a3: The group is headquartered in Treis-Karden (Rhineland-Palatinate) and operates primarily in Rhineland-Palatinate, North Rhine-Westphalia, Hesse, and Saarland, with supra-regional and international project execution.
